about_intro_p1: 2025年に設立された印日商工会議所（IJCC）は、アジアで最もダイナミックで補完的な2つの経済大国であるインドと日本の間に強力な二国間の架け橋を築く登録信託です。
about_intro_p2: IJCCは急速に制度的な信頼性を確立しました。Spolto（スポーツテクノロジー）、Nihon Edutech（日印スキルと就職）、IIA（インド産業協会）、Wadhwani Foundation（AIを活用したスキリング）、SEM（フルサービスイベントパートナー）と正式なMOUを締結しています。

team_sushilKumarChauhan_title: VC– Manufacturing Excellence, TQM & Japan-India Industrial Collaboration
team_sushilKumarChauhan_bio:
Mr. Sushil Chauhan is a seasoned Strategic Consultant with over 32 years of progressive experience in global automotive manufacturing, including a distinguished 29-year career at Honda Cars India Ltd. He has built a formidable reputation for bridging Indian manufacturing operations with world-class global benchmarks through the seamless integration of Japanese management philosophies — TQM, TPM, and Lean methodologies. His operational achievements are remarkable: driving JD Power No. 1 rankings for 17 consecutive years, achieving a 99.5% Global Direct Pass rate, maintaining Zero Accidents for 12 straight years (2008–2020), and delivering cost savings of ₹1,278 million through strategic initiatives spanning capacity enhancement, localization, and business process outsourcing.

Beyond operations, Sushil is a certified Honda Motors Advanced TQM Instructor and DDI-certified Business Competency trainer who has conducted 120+ training sessions for 2,000+ associates across India, Indonesia, and the Philippines. He has demonstrated strong leadership in greenfield projects — including a ₹885 million Injection Molding and Plastic Painting factory — and has championed organizational transformation by developing talent pipelines, restructuring workforce hierarchies, and digitizing training systems. A respected industry voice, he serves as a CII Advisory Committee Member and has led teams to first-place finishes in National and International Skill Olympics, embodying his personal motto: "Stay committed to your decision but stay flexible in your approach."
team_parijatTiwari_title: Sr. Consultant (Indo-Japan Bilateral Trade & Economic Relations)
team_parijatTiwari_bio:
Mr. Parijat is a trilingual professional with nearly 29 years of diverse experience spanning Japanese language interpretation, corporate business development, and IT systems analysis. Fluent in English, Hindi, and Japanese, he has spent over 12 years as a freelance Japanese interpreter, facilitating high-stakes business meetings, negotiations, site visits, and bilateral delegations across industries as varied as manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, energy, banking, semiconductors, and media. His corporate career includes an 11-year tenure at Hitachi India Pvt. Ltd. as Deputy General Manager — Infrastructure Division — where he served as an integrity champion, liaised with Japanese government institutions (NEDO, JETRO, JICA), and was honoured with the prestigious global "Inspiration of the Year" award in 2015 for his ICT-based Green Hospital concept.

A commerce graduate from the renowned Sri Ram College of Commerce (Delhi University) and holder of a 4-year Advanced Japanese Language certification from MOSAI Institute, Parijat brings a rare combination of linguistic mastery and corporate acumen to every engagement. His clientele reads like a who's who of Japanese industry — Toyota, Honda, Suzuki, Panasonic, Sharp, Toshiba, Mitsubishi, and many more — along with engagements for JETRO, JICA, and various Japanese prefectural delegations visiting India. With a valid 5-year Japan Multiple Entry Business Visa and extensive cross-sector experience, he is a trusted bridge-builder between Japanese and Indian business ecosystems.
team_krishnanNarayanan_title: Executive Director – Human Capital & Workforce Strategy
team_krishnanNarayanan_bio:
Mr. Krishnan is a seasoned technology and education entrepreneur with over 25 years of experience in the Financial Services Technology sector and a deep passion for leveraging technology to transform learning. He has held senior leadership roles at globally renowned institutions including Citibank Tokyo (Vice President), UBS Investment Bank Japan (Director), Prudential Corporation Asia (Head of IT), and UBS Singapore (Managing Director & Head of IT), building a distinguished track record in managing large multi-cultural teams, offshore development centres, and complex software delivery across Web, Mobile, Cloud, Analytics, and Mainframe platforms. A PhD in Business Administration from Singapore Management University further sharpens his expertise in organizational development and micro-coaching-based learning effectiveness.

Today, Krishnan serves as CEO of Nihon Edutech Private Limited — an India-headquartered specialist training and placement firm operating across Asia — and as Founder Director of NCAREERS, a Singapore-based platform connecting skilled workers and engineers to overseas employment opportunities in Japan, Germany, Australia, the UK, and USA. Partnered with the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) and powered by an AI-driven recruit-train-place-support platform, he is on a mission to accelerate skilling through self-managed learning and micro-coaching interventions. Professionally fluent in Japanese and bilingual in Tamil and English, Krishnan uniquely bridges the worlds of global finance, technology, and Japan-focused workforce development.

advisor_lctrivedi_bio:
Mr. Lalit Chandra Trivedi is one of India's most experienced railway executives, with nearly four decades of leadership service in Indian Railways, culminating in the Apex Grade position of General Manager, East Central Railway. A Fellow of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (IMechE), London, and an alumnus of HEC Paris and Carnegie Mellon University, he brings a rare combination of deep operational mastery, industrial policy expertise, and global strategic advisory capability.

Since founding LCT Engineers in 2022, he has advised government bodies, multilateral agencies, global OEMs, and Indian industrial groups on railway market entry, technology transfer, joint venture structuring, and infrastructure project development. His practitioner knowledge spans high-speed and semi-high-speed rail systems, rolling stock manufacturing, localization strategy, PPP concession models, and Make-in-India industrial policy — making him uniquely equipped to bridge the gap between international rail technology ecosystems and the Indian market.

contact_faq_a3: 会員は、ネットワーキングイベント、貿易使節団、市場情報への独占的なアクセスを得ることができ、また当会議所の会員ディレクトリに掲載されます。
contact_faq_q4: IJCCは日本企業のインド市場参入を支援していますか？
contact_faq_a4: はい。市場調査、パートナー探し、および法人設立のガイダンスを含むエンドツーエンドのサポートを提供しています。
contact_faq_q5: IJCCはインド企業の日本展開を支援していますか？
contact_faq_a5: もちろんです。ビジネスマッチング、見本市への参加を促進し、日本のビジネス文化や規制に関するアドバイスを提供します。
contact_faq_q6: 日本語研修は提供していますか？
contact_faq_a6: JLPT対策のためのリソースとサポートを提供し、会員を信頼できる語学研修パートナーに紹介します。
contact_faq_q7: 非会員向けのイベントはありますか？
contact_faq_a7: ほとんどのイベントは会員限定ですが、オープンなウェビナーや文化祭を随時開催しています。詳細はイベントページをご覧ください。
contact_faq_q8: 会費はどのように計算されますか？
contact_faq_a8: 会費はカテゴリー（法人、中小企業、個人など）によって異なります。詳細な価格は「料金体系」ページに記載されています。
contact_faq_q9: IJCCのイベントのスポンサーになるにはどうすればよいですか？
contact_faq_a9: すべての主要なイベントでスポンサーの機会をご用意しています。ブランディングチーム（info@ijcc.in）までご連絡ください。
contact_faq_q10: IJCCは日本行きのビザ申請を支援してくれますか？
contact_faq_a10: ビジネス使節団向けのサポートおよび推薦状を提供しています。個人ビザについては、公式の領事館手続きをご案内します。

aima_hero_desc: 印日商工会議所（IJCC）は、インド政府教育省公認の国家最高経営団体である全インド経営協会（AIMA）とMOUを締結しました。
aima_about_p1: 1957年に設立されたAIMAは、インドの経営協会の全国連盟です。3,000以上の企業組織と40万人の経営専門家を結集しています。
